applications.title: Site Plan Review - Change of use at 7611 Main St.

fields.description: The applicant is presenting a site plan for 7611 Main St., showing the redevelopment of the first-floor interior space from a single use pottery center into a multi-use space with two retail business suites and an office space. The second floor will remain as existing storage and a single residential unit. All major modifications will be taking place inside of the building. All principle permitted uses in the B-L zone, where a building permit and zoning certificate are required for improvements involving building renovation, parking, or new construction, are also subject to a site plan review by the Planning Commission per Town Code §180-95 (A) 9.
